backgroundPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production Worldlet Village Applet BACKGROUND PLATE for {title}, landscape 16:9.
REFERENCE 1: existing focus background, use its rich purposeful RIGHT-HAND furniture, layered props, atmosphere and meaningful branded objects. REFERENCE 2: existing icon, preserve its recognisable identity/colors but no icon pedestal needed. REFERENCE 3: Village calendar background, match its polished storybook sculpted 3D village aesthetic and usable front-facing surface, NOT photographic realism.
Setting: {setting}
LEFT: {surface} integrated physically into setting. Large front-facing nearly rectangular blank usable area x5–65%, y14–81%, subtle light ivory material, unobstructed and no printed UI. Frame mounted plausibly on wall/desk/easel; correct contact shadows. No forced perspective across usable surface.
RIGHT x69–100%: create a rich lived-in functional vignette, as engaging and detailed as reference1. Furnishings, task-related instruments, layered shelves, plants, small textiles, foreground and background depth; objects tell what this app does. Recognizable brand mark on a real useful object plus a modest "{title}" label; NOT an enormous billboard, giant floating logo, or generic sign. Use varied functions/materials and actual setting, not another bridge/mountains scene. Keep only a small companion landing patch near lower right, not a whole empty half.
Warm daylight, cream stone, tactile timber/brass/ceramic, coherent lighting, soft stylized shapes, saturated but tasteful greenery. Rich exterior or interior as setting dictates. Blank LEFT content surface must dominate usable area while RIGHT remains visually rich. No people, no companion character, no UI overlay, no watermarks. No dynamic sample content yet.
effectPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exquisite final applet design effect for {title}, landscape 16:9.
Input image is the CURRENT BACKGROUND EDIT TARGET. Preserve exactly the camera, outer frame silhouette and dimensions, all right-hand scenery, objects, colors, lighting, village buildings and icon-related props. DO NOT redesign or resize the background. Fill the entire existing large blank LEFT surface, approximately 70% of image width and 80% height, with a highly polished, readable and genuinely useful application design. Preserve the existing narrow frame; content meets its inner edge with no extra mat, no large empty margins and no floating inset app window. The original frame is the topmost foreground layer over the content edge.
APPLICATION DESIGN: {concept}
Visual quality: beautiful finely textured paper or appropriate game-board material, elegant legible dark ink, tactile linen tabs and shallow embossed brass/wood controls, natural paper edges and small contact shadows lit in exactly the same direction as the scene. Embedded photographs or painted thumbnails where useful, crisp lines and satisfying fine detail. Rich but calm and practical, not flat generic dashboard styling. Content occupies the real usable area generously with balanced density, never a tiny UI in a giant blank board. App-specific content and intentional typography, not decorative filler. Main heading and important controls large enough to read; short realistic English fictional data only.
Implementation-aware: flat front-facing primary content surface, normal aligned rows/cards/text, modest material depth; dynamic text and images could later be rendered in HTML. Do not fragment the working surface into excessive odd shapes. Fill any EXISTING small secondary blank plaque with the relevant date, status or progress stated by the concept; do not create new panels in the scenery. Keep lower-right scene available for the companion, but do NOT draw a fox or character.
Output is one complete image-generated VISUAL CONCEPT, not a photograph of a monitor, not a screenshot and not a collage. No outside browser chrome, watermarks, explanatory labels, laptops, extra pedestals, or dark overlays. Preserve the Village storybook sculpted/painterly aesthetic; no new photorealistic environment. All content fictional. Preserve every existing background edge and right-side detail.
STRICT EDITORIAL REQUIREMENTS: title the app clearly. No inspirational quotes, mottos, slogans or decorative filler sentences. Use the space for working information and useful controls. Fictional URLs and email addresses use example.com.

brandLayouts.code: Repository workspace: small project navigation, selected repository "village-garden", a thoughtful pull-request review with three changed files, a short readable code diff, status checks and a crafted Review button. If this is a coding-agent product, show its task conversation, three completed steps and a proposed file diff instead of a repository home.
brandLayouts.workspace: Personal workspace with a narrow page index, a large project notebook, two meaningful task cards and a small schedule strip. Show "Autumn workshop" with an illustrated garden cover and clear next actions, warm paper blocks with refined tactile tabs.
brandLayouts.knowledge: A linked-notes research vault: slim note index, an open well-typeset note "A garden through the seasons", a small beautifully drawn relationship graph, a clipped botanical illustration and backlink labels. Keep useful writing area generous.
brandLayouts.finance: A highly readable account or payments ledger: three summary figures, a modest ink trend chart, four realistic fictional transaction rows with dates and statuses, and two useful actions. Use brass-edged ledger tabs and cream paper, not decorative coin clutter inside the working area. Include "Sample account" subtly.
brandLayouts.tasks: An elegant tangible task notebook: Today and Upcoming tabs, five readable tasks grouped by project, checkboxes, one completed item, one dated reminder and a small project-color ribbon. Rich paper layering and subtle cloth controls; generous comfortable spacing.
brandLayouts.kanban: A useful project planning board: three columns "Planned", "In progress", "Done", with two carefully typeset task cards in each, small priority marks, owner initials and a visible project heading. Cards feel like thick paper clipped to the board; not oversized empty boxes.
brandLayouts.database: A developer database console reimagined as a refined physical registry: project name, small table navigation, four rows of fictional data in a crisp table, a connection/status strip and a compact usage chart. All tabular content must remain flat and readable.
brandLayouts.deploy: A deployment/service dashboard as a beautiful operations ledger: project "village-web", green Healthy status, three recent deployments with branch and time, one small traffic chart and a clear Deploy action. Fine brass tabs and paper cards, no giant pointless gauges.
brandLayouts.wellness: A tasteful wellness journal with three readings, a compact seven-day trend, a daily activity or recovery card and a short routine list. Use fictional illustrative metrics, avoid diagnostic claims. Tiny botanical illustration and restrained soft colored ink.
brandLayouts.activity: An activity journal with a beautiful small route map, distance 4.8 km, time 32 min, elevation 85 m, a weekly chart and three recent activities. Orange route thread and physical paper card craft, no generic office dashboard.
brandLayouts.map: An inviting navigation interface: a large detailed illustrated village map inset occupying most of the paper, a slim saved-places list, a clear route between two locations and a compact distance/time direction card. Muted cartographic paper, attractive route markers.
brandLayouts.stays: A travel stay-planning board: two beautiful cottage photos on cream photo prints, a clear location/date/guest selector, two listing cards with names and sample prices, and a compact reservation summary. Images and interface should feel like a curated guesthouse travel folio.
brandLayouts.itinerary: A well-designed trip folio: a three-day dated itinerary, transport and stay cards, a small route illustration and one clipped destination photo. Tickets have believable paper perforation and brass clips without compromising readable rows.
brandLayouts.feed: A readable social community feed with three distinct short fictional posts, small avatars or initial medallions, one attractive village photo, replies and a narrow channel/topic rail. Physical warm paper, restrained brand-color accents, no real private accounts.
brandLayouts.video: A media browsing/player design: one large inviting illustrated video poster with play control, timeline, readable title and channel, plus three smaller recommendation thumbnails. Appropriate to the named service: live indicators for livestream products, film cards for streaming movies. Match the tactile cinema scene.
brandLayouts.short-video: A short-video browsing design with one central portrait-format video poster, clear play and progress controls, a readable caption, compact vertical action controls and two smaller queued clips. Illustrated village-life content; enough breathing room, no real people or private accounts.
brandLayouts.chat: A beautiful conversation workspace: narrow channel/contact column, three readable chat exchanges, one attached photo card and a clear message composer. Threaded conversations for workplace products; personal message bubbles for messengers. Paper and linen microtexture, subtle useful branded tabs.
brandLayouts.meeting: A village meeting workspace: a large four-person grid represented by tasteful illustrated avatar/initial tiles, an adjacent agenda with three items, one note card, small microphone/camera controls and a clear Join meeting button. No photographs of real people.
brandLayouts.food: An appetizing food ordering board with two richly illustrated meal photos, readable restaurant/menu names, prices and timing, a compact basket summary and a clear order-review action. Warm ceramic food colors, paper menu and restrained brand accents.
brandLayouts.word-game: A crisp six-by-five Wordle letter grid with two plausible sample guesses, green/gold/cream tiles, a compact letter keyboard and restrained game status. Tiles feel tactile and fit exactly in the working area. No unrelated app dashboard.
brandLayouts.connections: An attractive four-by-four Connections word-tile puzzle with sixteen readable words, two softly highlighted selected tiles, small mistakes counter, Shuffle and Submit controls. Rounded thick-paper tiles in the game colors, generous readable type.
brandLayouts.arcade: A convincing playable-looking game window for the named game: a large illustrated game field, appropriate recognizable game objects, score and small controls. Match the game genre and icon: snakes and pellets, colorful cells, or toy block arena as appropriate. Keep all play content inside the reserved area.
brandLayouts.drawing: A drawing-game interface with a large central canvas showing a charming simple hand-drawn garden object, colored pencils/tools along an edge, a readable guessing chat and short timer. Clearly the named drawing game, tactile art supplies around a practical canvas.
brandLayouts.craft: A delightful element-combining game: a wide open cream workspace with a few arranged illustrated element tokens, a slim inventory showing Water, Fire, Earth and Wind and two discovered combinations. Beautiful small illustrated tokens and clear labels, not a busy wall of icons.
brandLayouts.cookie: A satisfying Cookie Clicker game interface: one large richly rendered chocolate-chip cookie, readable cookie count, a small production rate and three upgrade cards with mini bakery illustrations. Keep most play space clear, warm delicious material detail.
brandLayouts.chess: A beautiful chess interface with a large exact 8x8 chessboard, a plausible opening position, readable clocks and a slim move list. Realistic carved wooden pieces and ivory/dark squares; direct front view for usable game positioning.
brandLayouts.racing: A convincing race-game view for the named game: a large toy-like track/game scene, the recognizable car or runner, score and compact start/restart controls. Use a colorful miniature world, avoid any screenshot framing floating over the overall painting.
brandLayouts.game-library: A charming game-selection board with four distinct illustrated game cover cards, readable titles, tiny genre labels and one clear Play action. Rich covers, beautiful paper cards, good hierarchy and spare space for actual browsing.
brandLayouts.cards: A polished UNO-style card-game table with a draw pile, discard pile and a readable hand of seven colorful cards, opponent card backs and clear turn indicator. Detailed physical cards with consistent lighting, ample play area, no random dashboard widgets.
brandLayouts.platformer: A playful platform game view with a yellow cube character, a coherent simple level of platforms and toy hazards, a level number and small restart control. Clear legibility and spare play field, consistent village-toy materials.
brandLayouts.battle: A monster battle strategy view with two charming illustrated opposing creatures, compact health bars, readable move buttons and a small team lineup. Fictional battle state, toy-like friendly style, no gore or real people.
brandLayouts.assistant: An inviting AI assistant conversation: short user request about planning a village workshop, a useful structured response with a small itinerary/checklist, one beautifully illustrated supporting card, a clear composer and a few suggestion chips. Match this specific assistant brand while retaining village paper and cloth materiality.
brandLayouts.research: A research reader with a thoughtful question, a short structured answer or encyclopedia passage, three compact source cards and one relevant botanical/architectural illustration. Clear citations visually represented as numbered references, fictional sample content, generous reading area.
brandLayouts.files: A tangible but practical file library: a slim folder rail, three tasteful document/image previews, four readable file rows with type and modified date, search and upload/new-folder controls. Paper folders and colored linen tabs, attractive thumbnail images.
brandLayouts.document: An elegant document reader/editor: small page thumbnails, a large readable manuscript titled "The village workshop", a short heading and two paragraphs, one small illustration, a light formatting toolbar and a compact comment tab. Flat readable page, tasteful paper grain.
brandLayouts.spreadsheet: A carefully typeset spreadsheet on a physical ledger: columns Item, Planned, Actual and Notes; five sample household or workshop rows; a small total summary and modest bar chart. Thin crisp grid lines, aligned numbers, letter/row headers and small formula bar. No distorted perspective.
brandLayouts.slides: A presentation workspace: three small slide thumbnails at left, one large title slide "Growing together" with an elegant garden illustration and two concise points, a short speaker-note strip. Projector-screen aesthetic with warm paper and brass controls.
brandLayouts.design: A creative design canvas: slim tool rail, two attractive miniature poster/card artboards, color swatches and a small layer/properties panel. Show actual attractive designed pieces about an autumn village gathering; no generic placeholder rectangles.
brandLayouts.music: A listening library: a richly illustrated album cover, album/playlist title, visible play/pause and progress controls, three track rows with durations and a tiny queue. Physical sleeve, linen tabs and warm brass details, precise and inviting.
brandLayouts.photos: A curated photographic scrapbook interface: six DIFFERENT charming illustrated countryside photos, readable album tabs and subtle import/search controls. Thick photo-paper edges and soft shadows, varied food/garden/market/lake imagery, careful alignment and large useful viewing area.
brandLayouts.jobs: A professional opportunities workspace: profile summary, three fictional job cards with role/location/status, one highlighted application and a useful networking note. Restrained blue identity, refined paper portfolio materials, readable business-like hierarchy.
brandLayouts.shop: A useful shopping board with three appealing illustrated products matching village life (book, ceramic mug, woven basket), readable names/prices, search and category tabs, and a compact basket panel. Crafted catalog paper, tactile product photos and restrained branded controls.
brandLayouts.mail: A refined mail workspace: narrow mailbox and message list, an open invitation letter with readable sender/subject/body and a clipped garden photograph, reply and compose controls. Thin paper layers, brass clip, thoughtful warm spacing.
brandLayouts.podcast: A podcast listening library: two beautiful distinct illustrated episode covers, selected episode title and short description, a working-looking progress player with time, and three episode rows. Letterpress cover craft and restrained purple/brass accents.
brandLayouts.video-edit: A video editing desk view: large illustrated video preview, three source-media thumbnails, a clear timeline with three colored clip strips, playhead and a small export control. Tactile film-strip and paper labels, precise flat timeline, generous preview.
brandLayouts.analytics: Product analytics on a printed dashboard with clear weekly activity chart, funnel steps, retention heatmap and three summary metrics, annotated ink axes and restrained amber accents.
